description: Read the canonical workspace Explore overview, including lineages, latest snapshots, recommendations, capabilities, and blocking reasons. Each snapshot carries signalRanking: its terms ordered by observed demand signals with an evidenceLevel (strong/indicative/untested), usable for prioritising even when the calibrated index is null. The default summary view omits evidence bodies; read a snapshot with socialseal_explore_get for full components and evidence.

view.description: summary (default) omits snapshot diagnostics and evidence manifests; read one snapshot with socialseal_explore_get for full evidence.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace UUID. Reads resolve the live configured workspace when omitted.
